plays.desc_ko: 경기 초반 정글 시작 시점. 놓인 와드를 Tatu(리 신)가 패시브로 정리하고, FUR은 Oner의 지연 인베이드를 막기 위해 칼날부리 근처에 와드를 둠.
plays.desc_en: At the start of the jungle phase, Tatu (Lee Sin) clears a placed ward with his passive, and FUR drops a ward near the raptors to deter a delayed invade from Oner.
plays.quote: Tattoo able to clear it out ... have that ward around

plays.desc_ko: 라인전 초반 봇 라인 교환. Keria(카밀)가 진입해 두 명을 띄웠으나 Peyz가 독성 폭발을 맞아 더 들어가지 못했고, 해설은 좋은 진입이지만 얻은 것은 크지 않다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: Keria (Camille) engages early in bot lane and knocks up two, but Peyz gets hit by Noxious Blast and can't follow further; the casters call it a good engage with little gained.
plays.quote: As Carrier goes in hits two ... doesn't gain them too

plays.desc_ko: T1이 봇 사이드에서 공격적으로 진입(인베이드/다이브). Jojo는 기둥 너머로 점멸했지만 Oner의 점멸 진입으로 Jojo를 잡음. Oner는 포탑 공격을 맞으며 사실상 자기 목숨을 바쳐 킬을 가져감. 리플레이에서 Keria가 레벨2 Jojo에게 자신 있게 진입했고 Peyz는 스킬이 빠진 상태였다고 설명.
plays.desc_en: T1 aggressively dives bot side; JoJo flashes over a pillar, but Oner flashes in to take him down, essentially trading his own life under tower for the kill. The replay shows Keria confidently engaging on a level-2 JoJo while Peyz's abilities were on cooldown.
plays.quote: a massive engage down towards ... owner will get it. Takes a tower shot ... One for one.

plays.desc_ko: T1 진입 직후 FUR의 반격. Keria가 회수하려다 독성 폭발에 걸렸고, 마나가 부족한 Ayu가 쌍독니를 맞히지 못했지만 Tatu가 후속으로 들어가 더블킬. 해설은 FUR의 큰 플레이로 평가.
plays.desc_en: FUR strikes back right after T1's engage: Keria is caught by Noxious Blast while retreating, and although a low-mana Ayu misses Twin Fang, Tatu follows up for a double kill in what the casters call a big play for FUR.
plays.quote: catches ... But Tatu follows up ... for the double.

plays.desc_ko: Oner가 정비로 늦어진 사이 Keria가 봇 라인으로 급습. Ayu가 점멸했지만 Keria의 진입과 Peyz의 어둠 구체 연계로 T1 봇 듀오가 더블 점멸을 써서 Ayu를 처치. Ayu는 웨이브를 밀고 빠지던 중이었고 텔레포트가 있었다는 회고 설명 포함.
plays.desc_en: With Oner delayed by his reset, Keria (Camille) jumps bot lane; Ayu flashes, but Keria's engage and Peyz's Dark Sphere combo, using both Flashes, take him down. Ayu had been shoving and backing off with Teleport available.
plays.quote: here comes Caria just swooping ... Are you has to flash ... Double flash

plays.desc_ko: 탑 라인에서 Tatu와 Guigo가 Doran을 공격. Guigo의 점멸 진입과 Tatu의 스킬로 Doran을 처치해 Tatu가 연속 킬(3/0). 해설은 Doran이 텔레포트가 없을 때 죽은 점을 강조.
plays.desc_en: Tatu and Guigo collapse on Doran top; Guigo's flash engage and Tatu's abilities secure the kill, putting Tatu at 3/0. The casters stress that Doran died without Teleport.
plays.quote: another fight. ... flash in from Grigo enough to get Tatsu ... on a killing spree on this Lee Sin.

plays.desc_ko: Keria가 진입 스킬을 쓰며 들어갔고 상대 스킬 지속시간이 끝남. 갈고리 벽 진입을 맞히지 않기로 했는데, 해설은 들어갔다면 너무 깊었을 것이라고 평가.
plays.desc_en: Keria goes in with his engage as the enemy ability duration runs out, but opts not to land Hookshot on the wall; the casters say it would have been too deep.
plays.quote: Keria going in for the Shadow Assault. ... Keria deciding the hook shot wall dive

plays.desc_ko: Oner가 옆에서 미드로 돌아 들어와 Tuts를 노림. 트런들 기둥에 막힐 뻔한 Tuts가 벽 점멸로 탈출했고 Keria가 합류했지만 마무리하지 못함. 해설은 Tuts가 살아남은 것이 중요했다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: Oner rotates in from the side to target Tutsz (Ryze); nearly trapped by Pillar of Ice, Tutsz flashes over a wall, and Keria arrives but can't finish. The casters note his survival was important.
plays.quote: Owner coming ... Tuts tries to flash the wall, manages to ... escape

plays.desc_ko: Jojo가 귀환해 미드를 통해 복귀 중이라 드래곤 쪽 합류까지 약 10초 걸린다는 서술.
plays.desc_en: JoJo recalls and returns through mid, about 10 seconds away from joining at the dragon.
plays.quote: has just recalled

plays.desc_ko: Tatu가 서포터보다 약 5초 앞서 드래곤을 시작. 이후 해설이 '드래곤이 넘어가는' 상황과 FUR의 드래곤 2개를 언급.
plays.desc_en: Tatu starts the dragon about five seconds ahead of his support, and the casters later mention the dragon going over and FUR's two dragons.
plays.quote: Has started up the drake. ... With the dragon going over

plays.desc_ko: 드래곤 근처에서 Keria가 독성 폭발에 발각되고 Ayu의 쌍독니가 들어감. Keria는 점프로 빠지려 했지만 점멸이 없어 쌍독니를 맞음.
plays.desc_en: Near the dragon, Keria is spotted by Noxious Blast and Ayu (Cassiopeia) lands Twin Fang; Keria tries to jump away but, without Flash, gets hit.
plays.quote: Keria spotted out with a Noxious Blast. ... flash and no place to go ... Carrier feels the sting of the

plays.desc_ko: 드래곤이 FUR 쪽으로 넘어가는 동안 Oner가 탑으로 다이브. 해설은 완벽히 실행된 다이브라 평가하고 Guigo가 포탑을 내줬어야 했다고 언급. 이후 Oner가 탑에서 킬을 땄다는 회고 언급.
plays.desc_en: As FUR takes the dragon, Oner dives top in what the casters call a perfectly executed dive, saying Guigo should have given up the tower; Oner later secures a kill top.
plays.quote: owner going for dive at top. ... perfectly executed dive. ... owner after getting the kill in top is

plays.desc_ko: Tatu가 T1 칼날부리 등 캠프를 훔치려 했으나 Keria에게 밀려남. 해설은 자신의 돌거북·레드가 살아 있어 타이밍이 나빴다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: Tatu tries to steal T1's raptors and other camps but is pushed out by Keria; the casters say the timing was poor since his own Gromp and red were still up.
plays.quote: Tatu getting pushed off raptors by ... Tatu was hoping he could sneak in and

plays.desc_ko: Oner가 FUR 탑 사이드 정글을 가져가려는 상황에서 Jojo가 넘어와 Tatu의 레드 버프를 지켜냄.
plays.desc_en: As Oner looks to take FUR's top-side jungle, JoJo crosses over to protect Tatu's red buff.
plays.quote: Jojo is now ... Jojo able to save that red buff

plays.desc_ko: 파워 스파이크를 맞은 Tatu가 진입하고 Jojo, Guigo의 텔레포트가 합류. Faker의 충격파가 두 명을 묶어 끌어오고 Peyz가 두 번째 킬, 이어 Guigo까지 잡혀 Peyz 더블킬. 해설은 3대5 숫자 싸움이었다고 회고.
plays.desc_en: A spiking Tatu engages with JoJo and Guigo's Teleport joining, but Faker's Shockwave pulls in two, Peyz gets the second kill, then catches Guigo for a double kill. The casters recall it as a 3v5 numbers fight.
plays.quote: Tatu goes in. Jojo here as well. TP from ... The shockwave's going to land on two ... Pays secures the second

plays.desc_ko: Guigo가 탑에서 Doran을 노리고 Doran이 맞교환하는 사이 Oner가 대기하다 제압(subjugate)을 사용. Guigo는 결국 기둥 너머로 점멸해 빠져나감.
plays.desc_en: Guigo targets Doran top, and as they trade Oner waits to use Subjugate, but Guigo flashes over the pillar to escape.
plays.quote: Quidco is looking for ... He has got owner ... He has to flash over the pillar in the

plays.desc_ko: 봇 삼거리 부쉬 쪽으로 침입이 있었으나 T1이 Peyz와 Keria를 안전하게 보호.
plays.desc_en: FUR invades toward the bot tribush, but T1 keeps Peyz and Keria safe.
plays.quote: we see a bit of an invade ... T1 able to safely protect Pays and

plays.desc_ko: 강가에서 Keria가 Tatu를 피해 대시했으나 Peyz는 독성 폭발을 피해 점멸, Tatu가 용의 분노로 Keria를 걷어차 Rell 기절·Ryze 공간 왜곡 쪽으로 보냄. Tatu가 점멸 추격, Oner가 보호하려다 벽 반대편에 고립되고 쌍독니로 Ayu가 마무리. FUR의 2대0 교환. 리플레이에서 Tatu의 와드 점프로 Oner가 킬 보상을 얻지 못했다는 설명.
plays.desc_en: In the river Keria dashes away from Tatu while Peyz flashes Noxious Blast; Tatu kicks Keria with Dragon's Rage into Rell's stun and Ryze's Realm Warp, flash-chases, and Oner gets isolated across a wall as Ayu finishes with Twin Fang for a 2-for-0. The replay shows Tatu's ward hop denied Oner the kill.
plays.quote: Tattoo goes in with Dragon's Rage kick, ... he can't do it ... takes it? Two for Nocturne in favor of

plays.desc_ko: 상대 정글러가 탑에 있음을 알고 Tatu가 드래곤을 시작. 이후 해설이 FUR의 드래곤 2개를 언급.
plays.desc_en: Knowing the enemy jungler is top, Tatu starts the dragon, and the casters later mention FUR's two dragons.
plays.quote: And Tatu will ... start up the drake knowing the enemy

plays.desc_ko: T1이 FUR을 정글에서 밀어내고 포탑 아래로 몰아넣은 뒤 다이브를 위협. Faker의 충격파가 Tuts에게 맞아 체력 절반을 깎았지만 원하는 만큼의 이득은 얻지 못하고 FUR은 후퇴.
plays.desc_en: T1 pushes FUR out of the jungle and under tower threatening a dive; Faker's Shockwave takes half of Tutsz's health, but T1 doesn't gain as much as hoped and FUR retreats.
plays.quote: T1's threatening a dive. ... Shockwave was just used on Tuts ... doesn't find as much of an advantage as

plays.desc_ko: FUR이 물러난 뒤 Doran이 탑 1차 포탑을 파괴. 경기 첫 포탑.
plays.desc_en: After FUR backs off, Doran takes the top outer tower, the first tower of the game.
plays.quote: Doran is able to take that top lane tier ... First tower of the game going over

plays.desc_ko: T1이 정글 장악과 함께 Jayce(Doran)를 봇 라인으로 이동시키는 중이라는 서술.
plays.desc_en: T1 controls the jungle while moving Doran (Jayce) to bot lane.
plays.quote: control of the jungle and they're moving ... Jayce bot lane to get even more

plays.desc_ko: 협곡의 전령 근처에서 Jojo가 앞으로 나가 두 명 기절, Tatu의 용의 분노로 두 명 띄움. 하지만 후속이 없었고 나머지 FUR이 합류하지 못함. 리플레이: Jojo가 잡히자 Keria·Oner가 즉시 진입, Jojo 사망 후 Faker 쪽 각이 있었지만 Doran이 리 신 Q를 몸으로 막아 Faker를 보호하고 Sion을 마무리.
plays.desc_en: Near the Rift Herald, JoJo steps up to stun two and Tatu kicks up two with Dragon's Rage, but FUR has no follow-up. The replay shows Keria and Oner collapsing on JoJo, then Doran body-blocking Lee Sin's Q to protect Faker and finishing Sion.
plays.quote: forward, crashes down, does get a good ... to follow up really for Furia ... Furia just can't get into the fight.

plays.desc_ko: 교전 후 T1이 협곡의 전령을 확보한 것으로 보임. 이후 해설이 T1의 전령 활용 계획을 언급.
plays.desc_en: T1 appears to secure the Rift Herald after the fight, and the casters discuss T1's plans for it.
plays.quote: Rift Herald. All the advantages going in ... Rift Herald for pressure around the

plays.desc_ko: FUR이 드래곤을 견제하지 않아 T1이 전령 압박 없이 첫 드래곤을 확보.
plays.desc_en: With FUR not contesting, T1 takes their first dragon without needing Herald pressure.
plays.quote: not going to contest the dragon ... T1 will just secure it

plays.desc_ko: Tuts의 공간 왜곡으로 측면 진입, Tatu의 킥이 Doran에게 들어가 Doran이 먼저 잡힘. Oner가 옆에서 오고 기둥으로 Doran이 걸어서 빠져나감. Peyz 진입, Tatu는 체력 절반, Guigo도 점멸로 이탈하며 Syndra 궁극기로도 처치 실패. 양측 궁 3개와 양 탑 라이너 점멸 소모.
plays.desc_en: Tutsz's Realm Warp opens a flank and Tatu kicks Doran, but Oner's pillar lets Doran walk out; Peyz engages, Tatu drops to half, and Guigo flashes away surviving even Syndra's ultimate. Both sides burn three ultimates and both top laners use Flash.
plays.quote: the Realm Warp ... we see a good kickback onto ... Doran able to walk away

plays.desc_ko: 잡담 중 Oner가 FUR의 레드 버프를 훔쳤다는 짧은 언급.
plays.desc_en: Amid casual banter, the casters briefly note Oner stole FUR's red buff.
plays.quote: owner just steals away a red,

plays.desc_ko: FUR이 Keria를 노렸으나 Keria가 옆걸음으로 피해 걸어서 빠져나감.
plays.desc_en: FUR goes for Keria, but he sidesteps and walks out.
plays.quote: As they're going for Carry ... side steps good enough

plays.desc_ko: Faker의 충격파 후 Faker가 Tuts를 쫓는 사이, Tatu가 음파 후 점멸 킥으로 Peyz를 걷어차고 Ayu의 쌍독니로 Peyz 처치. Tatu는 살아남으려 했으나 Keria와 Oner에게 잡혀 1대1 교환. Guigo의 텔레포트는 늦게 합류. 리플레이에서 Ayu에게 이어준 좋은 연계로 평가.
plays.desc_en: While Faker chases Tutsz after a Shockwave, Tatu lands Sonic Wave and Flash kicks Peyz into Ayu's Twin Fang for the kill, then is caught by Keria and Oner for a 1-for-1. Guigo's Teleport arrives late; the replay praises the setup for Ayu.
plays.quote: Good flash and kickback ... Pays will fall. ... but Carryon and owner take him out

plays.desc_ko: Jojo가 측면을 찾아 들어가자 Oner가 예언자의 렌즈로 발견. Jojo의 기절 시도, Guigo의 강타는 Oner가 피함. Tatu는 음파로 빠졌다가 재진입, Ayu 측면 합류, Ryze 룬 감옥과 Sion 강타로 Oner를 묶었으나 Oner가 제압(subjugate)으로 걸어서 빠져나감. 해설은 4~5명이 때렸지만 회복 때문에 처치 못했다고 회고.
plays.desc_en: JoJo flanks but Oner spots him with Oracle Lens; Oner dodges JoJo's stun and Guigo's Soul Furnace, then is locked by Rune Prison and Sion after Tatu re-engages and Ayu flanks, but walks out with Subjugate. The casters note 4–5 players hit him but his healing kept him alive.
plays.quote: find a little bit of a flank here. ... Rune prison on ... but he just walks out

plays.desc_ko: FUR의 공격이 끝난 직후 Keria가 Tuts에게 점멸 진입, Oner도 합류. Tuts는 벽 점멸을 시도했으나 점화로 처치된 것으로 보이며 Tatu, Jojo, Ayu는 도주. T1은 이후 바론을 노리며 물러날 것이라는 예측.
plays.desc_en: Right after FUR's attack ends, Keria flashes onto Tutsz with Oner joining; Tutsz's wall flash appears to fail as Ignite finishes him, while Tatu, JoJo and Ayu flee. T1 is expected to reset toward Baron.
plays.quote: Keria goes with the flash onto Tusi. ... the wall with the ignite and up to kill ... Tatu, Jojo, and Ayu are on the run

plays.desc_ko: T1이 바론을 시작. Oner의 기둥이 Tatu의 보호의 손길을 끊어 Tatu가 점멸을 씀. 시야 확인 후 Oner가 바론을 계속 침(체력 12000 언급). Doran은 Jojo의 둥지 접근을 견제.
plays.desc_en: T1 starts Baron; Oner's pillar cuts off Tatu's Safeguard, forcing Tatu's Flash, and after checking vision Oner keeps hitting Baron at around 12,000 health while Doran zones JoJo from the pit.
plays.quote: pillar. He has to flash. ... Interrupts him out of his safeguard with ... Owner's going to continue clubbing that

plays.desc_ko: Tatu는 위쪽, Guigo는 아래쪽에서 협공으로 바론 견제. Guigo가 Oner의 제압에 맞아 물러났고, 이어 Guigo의 돌진으로 Doran이 점멸을 소모. 해설은 FUR의 좋은 저지·지연으로 평가.
plays.desc_en: Tatu from above and Guigo from below pincer the Baron; Guigo is pushed back by Oner's Subjugate, then his charge forces Doran's Flash. The casters praise FUR's delay.
plays.quote: Tattoo is coming from the ... has been turned on. Subjugate coming out ... Good stop overall from

plays.desc_ko: Keria가 Tatu를 노렸으나 Tatu가 침착하게 용의 분노로 카밀을 걷어차고 탈출. Jojo의 기절 지원도 있었으며 해설은 궁극기 2개 대 1개 소모로 정리.
plays.desc_en: Keria goes for Tatu, but Tatu calmly kicks Camille away with Dragon's Rage and escapes with JoJo's stun support, leaving two ultimates spent against one.
plays.quote: dragon's rage kick ... Shadow and strike from Jojo. ... That's two ultimates down for one.

plays.desc_ko: FUR이 바론 쪽에서 4대5도 감수하려는 분위기 속에 Jojo가 측면을 노리고 시야 장악. Jojo의 기절 시도가 Oner에게 들어갔으나 막히고 Doran이 Tatu를 맞히자 FUR이 몰래 바론을 포기.
plays.desc_en: FUR seems ready to fight 4v5 at Baron as JoJo flanks and takes vision, but his stun on Oner is blocked and Doran hits Tatu, so FUR quietly abandons Baron.
plays.quote: Jojo looking for the flank. Vision ... control for Furia. ... onto Owner.

plays.desc_ko: FUR이 바론 쪽에 있는 동안 Faker가 미드 2차 포탑으로 향하는 중.
plays.desc_en: With FUR at Baron, Faker heads toward the mid inner tower.
plays.quote: Faker's already on ... his way towards that mid lane tier two,

plays.desc_ko: 드래곤 생성 상황에서 Jojo가 앞으로 나섰고 회복이 들어갔지만 Faker의 충격파와 Peyz의 궁극기 피해로 Rell이 말에서 떨어짐(dismount).
plays.desc_en: As dragon spawns JoJo steps forward and gets healed, but Faker's Shockwave and Peyz's ultimate dismount Rell.
plays.quote: Jojo steps ... Shockwave and ... unleashed power enough to dismount the

plays.desc_ko: Jojo를 밀어낸 뒤 T1이 세 번째 드래곤을 완료.
plays.desc_en: After pushing JoJo back, T1 finishes their third dragon.
plays.quote: Drake is up. ... Third dragon completed for T1

plays.desc_ko: 해설자들의 대화 도중 Ayu가 측면 위협을 피해 점멸로 빠짐. 이후 해설이 Ayu가 앞서 점멸해야 했다고 회고.
plays.desc_en: During casters' chat, Ayu flashes away from a flank threat; they later say he should have flashed earlier.
plays.quote: would be Lion as I have to ... Flash is away from the side. ... Are you having to flash earlier on while

plays.desc_ko: 쌍독니가 Doran에게 들어갔으나 Doran이 돌아온 점멸로 빠짐. Tatu의 음파가 맞았지만 사거리가 닿지 않아 후속 불가.
plays.desc_en: Ayu lands Twin Fang on Doran, but Doran escapes with his returned Flash; Tatu's Sonic Wave hits but he's out of range to follow.
plays.quote: onto Doran who does ... have his flash back and will utilize it ... Tautu not in range

plays.desc_ko: Oner가 앞으로 나가 점멸+충격파 연계, Faker의 마그누스 폭풍(자막상)도 들어갔지만 Tatu가 피해서 생존하고 FUR 전원이 빠져나감.
plays.desc_en: Oner steps up for a Flash plus Shockwave combo along with Faker's ultimate, but Tatu dodges and all of FUR escapes.
plays.quote: Owner steps forward. ... dodge away and will manage to survive to ... All of Furia get out

plays.desc_ko: 교전에서 킬은 없었지만 FUR이 기지로 돌아가야 해 T1이 기지를 열고 억제기를 파괴. 해설은 미드 주도권과 바론 시도로 이어진다고 평가.
